metadata.preparation: Common unitary encoded known-state preparation for every round count; non-fault-tolerant
metadata.decoder: All 8 checks at each round plus 4 final data-derived checks; no physical corrections
metadata.timing: From the global barrier AFTER encoding to the barrier BEFORE final basis rotation/readout; boundary times from compiled prefixes, no guessed reset duration
metadata.idle_model: Effective homogeneous Pauli depolarization per us on all active qubits; not calibrated T1/T2

timing.method: Compiled global-barrier prefixes in the same batch as full schedules
